text: At 51 minutes, Kenji Rahman scored for Westport Albion after a slick move starting from a throw-in. This goal put Westport ahead 3-2, thanks to their strong build-up play and control of the game in the last 10 minutes, where they kept the ball more than half the time and shot twice on target.
